messages:
maya (Product PM): Quick sync — need rollout plan for model-v2 in EU. Goals: keep p95 latency <= 400ms, error rate < 0.5%, and quality regression <= 0.5% on the evaluation set. Must support instant fallback to model-v1. Any constraints?
liam (Eng): Proposing phased canary: shadow -> 0.5% -> 5% -> 25%. Shadow will run for 2h with full eval sampling. A/B will be on labeled prompts.
anya (SRE): Add circuit-breaker and kill-switch. Rollback triggers: 5xx rate > 1% for 5m OR p95 > 700ms for 3m. Also need alert routing to on-call and a manual rollback button in console.
sam (CS): Heads-up: two EU customers want to opt-in early. We need per-tenant opt-in flags + notification email template. Also include a short SLA note for them.
natalie (Security): Confirming: for Private/Dedicated we must enable KMS, audit logs, and ensure telemetry strips PII by default. I'll need a checklist before sign-off.
oliver (Infra): Autoscaling strategy: min 2 instances, scale on request rate and GPU mem. We'll provision a dedicated pool for EU dedicated tenants. Batching will be conservative during canary to avoid latency spikes.
liam (Eng): Flag config snippet (will land in prod-ops):
```json
{
  "flag": "model_v2_eu",
  "phases": [
    {"name": "shadow", "pct": 0, "duration": "2h"},
    {"name": "canary-1", "pct": 0.5, "duration": "4h"},
    {"name": "canary-2", "pct": 5, "duration": "12h"},
    {"name": "ramp", "pct": 25, "duration": "24h"}
  ],
  "kill_switch": "true",
  "per_tenant_opt_in": "true"
}
```
maya (Product PM): Draft launch checklist (basic):
- Perf: p95 <= 400ms and error rate < 0.5% at 25% for 24h
- Quality: A/B delta < 0.5% on eval set
- Security: KMS/audit sign-off
- CS: customers notified and opt-in ready
- Runbook: rollback + verification steps documented
anya (SRE): I'll add runbook steps: smoke test (sanity prompts), traffic cutover test, quick verification queries, and post-cutover monitoring dashboard. Also: playbook step to toggle kill-switch by CLI.
deploy-bot: canary-deploy started: model_v2_eu @1766001300 phase=shadow
liam (Eng): I'll own the rollout and create the runbook page. Will post links and the rollout experiment IDs once ready.
sam (CS): I'll prepare opt-in emails and a short FAQ for those two customers. Need final date/time for opt-in window.
natalie (Security): I'll run the checklist tomorrow morning and post a concise blocker/non-blocker verdict.
maya (Product PM): Owners: liam = rollout owner, anya = SRE lead, sam = customer comms, natalie = security sign-off. Preflight meeting 13:00 UTC tomorrow. Reply if you need a different time. :calendar:
liam (Eng): noted, will add traffic shaping knobs to the runbook and include test prompts.
anya (SRE): one more: add a throttling cap per-tenant during canary to protect bursty customers.
maya (Product PM): Great — thanks all. I want a short preflight checklist in this thread before we start phase 1.
